Batch-read and annotate every PEAKS export folder into pep_all format

Source: R/loaders-peaks.R
peaks_read_batch.Rd

Indexes the PEAKS export subfolders under folder (via the vendored get_dirs_index_peaks()), filters to those present in annotation, reads and joins each one with read_pep_peaks(), then derives the shared pep_all columns (ProteinFirst/GeneFirst/OrganismFirst, PeptideID, Log2Area, Length_range), drops decoys, and warns about any samples that could not be matched to the annotation table.

Usage

peaks_read_batch(
  folder,
  annotation,
  instrument = "tims_tof",
  shortpep_range = c(8, 13)
)

Arguments

folder

Top-level directory containing the PEAKS export subfolders.

annotation

Annotation data frame (output of read_annot(), joined with get_dirs_index_peaks()'s path_full column for matching).

instrument

Passed to read_pep_peaks(); one of "tims_tof", "faims_orbi", "orbi".

shortpep_range

Length 2 vector c(min, max) defining the Length_range classification window (8-13 AAs for HLA-I).

Value

The unified pep_all-format long data frame for every matched PEAKS sample.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
peaks_read_batch(file.path("2_data", "peaks_xpro"), annotation,
                 instrument = params$Instrument)
} # }
